must_identify.item: The api exits because it cannot resolve redis-master
must_identify.evidence: For the stale pod api-869d87b484-mwsv7 this fails DNS resolution: ... [Errno -2] Name does not resolve ... giving up: redis unavailable → sys.exit(1) → container exits with code 1 → CrashLoopBackOff

must_identify.item: REDIS_HOST is set to redis-master while the Service is named redis
must_identify.evidence: The still-terminating old ReplicaSet api-869d87b484 has REDIS_HOST=redis-master, a hostname that doesn't exist as a Service in the shop namespace (kubectl get svc -n shop lists only api, frontend, redis — no redis-master).

notes: The RCA reverses the direction of the change. It claims the latest deploy set REDIS_HOST=redis and that redis-master is a stale value in the old ReplicaSet, when the deploy actually introduced redis-master. As a result it calls the problem cosmetic and recommends scaling the crashing ReplicaSet to 0, which is not the acceptable fix of reverting REDIS_HOST or rolling back. A reviewer should check whether this misattribution should downgrade the verdict to wrong.
